entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: ¶My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves [are ready] for me. {breath...: or, spirit is spent}

words.text: [are ready] for me. {breath...: or, spirit is spent}

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: [Are there] not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation? {continue: Heb. lodge}

words.text: with me? and doth not mine eye

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who [is] he [that] will strike hands with me?

words.text: now, put me in a surety
with thee; who [is] he [that] will strike

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt [them].

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: He that speaketh flattery to [his] friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret. {aforetime: or, before them}

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members [are] as a shadow. {my members: or, my thoughts}

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: Upright [men] shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger. {be...: Heb. add strength}

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: ¶But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find [one] wise [man] among you.

words.text: as for you all, do ye return

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, [even] the thoughts of my heart. {the thoughts: Heb. the possessions}

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They change the night into day: the light [is] short because of darkness. {short: Heb. near}

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I wait, the grave [is] mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: I have said to corruption, Thou [art] my father: to the worm, [Thou art] my mother, and my sister. {said: Heb. cried, or, called}

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: And where [is] now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when [our] rest together [is] in the dust.
